    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Group Stage: September 21st - 24th, 2023
      • Single Round Robin
      • All matches are Ft3
      • Top 8 teams advance to Playoffs
    • Playoffs: October 6th - October 8th, 2023
      • Double elimination bracket
      • All matches (excl. Grand Finals) are Ft3
      • Grand Finals are Ft4
